AI Companies Scramble for Computing Power and Talent in Silicon Valley

In Silicon Valley, artificial intelligence companies are aggressively seeking both computing power and skilled talent, leading to significant shifts in the tech landscape. AI firms are reportedly poaching employees from established tech giants, while the demand for AI computing power is disrupting the region. Venture capitalists and AI founders have expressed optimism regarding a less regulated environment for AI development, with some cheering calls for the industry to self-police on safety matters.
